description: This file contains CSS styles for managing themes and styling the App component in a Tic Tac Toe game. It defines CSS variables for light and dark themes, styles for various elements including the App component, header, links, and a theme toggle button.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container for the application providing central alignment and responsive design.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section of the application styled with background color and flexbox layout.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button for toggling between light and dark themes with hover and active states.
